prompt: A calm cosy window seat at golden hour: a round cushion, a folded knitted blanket, a steaming mug of tea, a small open notebook with a ribbon, a sleeping cream cat curled up, a little potted fern and a soft moon lamp on the sill, gentle rain outside the window. No people, no text, no letters. Centred composition with soft empty space at the top. Cosy Animal Crossing New Horizons inspired soft 3D clay, rounded chunky shapes, smooth matte clay materials, gentle warm lighting, pastel pink, cream, sage and honey wood.
